name: Khazna AUH6 Masdar City data center
notes: Khazna's official AUH6 page places the facility in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi and describes an operational wholesale data center; Data Center Map lists the Masdar City AUH6 site with 31.8 MW power capacity. Capacity is from directory data, while project existence/location are official.

name: Equinix AD1 Abu Dhabi IBX
notes: Equinix's AD1 page lists its Abu Dhabi International Business Exchange facility in Masdar City; the original Equinix announcement described AD-IX/AD1 as the first carrier-neutral data center in the Middle East. Public MW capacity was not found.

name: Pure DC Abu Dhabi / Yas Island campus
notes: Pure DC's Abu Dhabi location page describes a UAE data center campus; DCD reported the 4 MW first phase launched in 2024 and later planning filings for a second 48 MW facility on Yas Island. Capacity records the planned second facility where public MW detail is available.

name: Gulf Data Hub Abu Dhabi KIZAD data center
notes: Trade press reported Gulf Data Hub breaking ground on an Abu Dhabi data center at KIZAD; Baxtel lists the KIZAD/ICAD1 facility as a 22 MW project. Public sources vary on naming between KIZAD and ICAD1, so location is noted at emirate/industrial-zone level.

name: Khazna AAN2 Al Ain data center
notes: Data center directories list Khazna AAN2 in Al Ain as an operational facility, with Data Center Map reporting 4.0 MW power capacity. I did not find a current public Khazna facility page exposing the same site details.

name: Etisalat Al Ain data center
notes: DCD reported Etisalat would build two UAE data centers, including one in Al Ain, and later covered Etisalat's UAE data-center launches. Public sources did not disclose MW capacity or a precise Al Ain address.

name: Stargate UAE / UAE-US AI Campus
developer: G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, SoftBank and partners
notes: G42 announced Stargate UAE as the first phase of the 5 GW UAE-US AI Campus in Abu Dhabi, with DCD reporting a 1 GW Stargate data center phase. Data Center Map places the project on Hameem Road, Abu Dhabi, which is used here to map it to Al Dhafra; the official announcement itself identifies Abu Dhabi but not the municipal division.

name: Khazna QAJ1 Ajman data center
notes: Khazna announced ground-breaking for QAJ1 in Ajman, described as its largest AI-optimized data center in the UAE and designed for 100 MW of power capacity. DCD also reported the same 100 MW Ajman project.

Targeted searches for Manama, Ajman with data center/datacenter/server farm/hyperscale terms found no verified public physical data-center facility or project. Ajman activity found in this batch is concentrated in Ajman city/QAJ1.
Targeted searches for Masfut, Ajman with data center/datacenter/server farm/hyperscale terms found no verified public physical data-center facility or project.

Searches for Deira/old Dubai and Sector 1 localities found telecom, exchange and cloud-service references, but no verified physical colocation, hyperscale or server-farm project that could be confidently placed in Dubai Sector 1.

name: Dubai Airports modular data centre at DXB
notes: Huawei announced a modular data centre for Dubai Airports at Dubai International (DXB), delivered with one-day deployment of each module; DCD also covered the project. DXB/airport-area siting maps this record to Dubai Sector 2; public MW capacity was not disclosed.

name: Khazna DXB2 Dubai Design District data center
notes: Dubai Internet City and Khazna announced two new data centres in Dubai in 2022; Data Center Map lists Khazna DXB2 in Dubai Design District with 21.45 MW, and Laing O'Rourke describes the DXB2 data centre project. d3/central Dubai siting maps this to Sector 3.

name: Moro Hub Dubai Marina data center
notes: Moro Hub markets UAE data-center services and DCD reported launch of a new 8.8 MW Dubai Marina data center, later covered as receiving Uptime Tier III certification. Dubai Marina maps this facility to Dubai Sector 3.

name: Etisalat 71 Umm Hurair data center
notes: Data center directories list an Etisalat facility at 71 Umm Hurair in Dubai offering colocation/connectivity. Umm Hurair is central Dubai and is mapped to Sector 3; public MW capacity was not found.

Targeted searches for Sector 4 localities such as Ras Al Khor, Nad Al Hammar, Al Warqaa and Dubai Creek Harbour found real-estate, telecom and generic cloud references, but no verified physical data-center project or facility in this division.
